mil3.7.14:1.2: “Venerable Nāgasena, is it possible to cut through the subtlest ofall things?”
mil3.7.14:1.3: “Yes, your majesty, it is possible to cut through the subtlest of all things.”
mil3.7.14:1.4: “Thenwhat, venerable sir, is the subtlest of all things?”
mil3.7.14:1.6:
Whatever is to be cut
through, all that is cut through by wisdom. There is nothing else other than
wisdom for cutting through.”
